description: Conversion of the garage into an office space and utility area to the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ([Existing Block Plan and Site Plan], [Site Photos], [Garage Existing Floor Plan], [Garage Existing Roof Plan], [Existing Side Elevations], [Existing Front and Rear Elevations], [Existing Side Elevations], [Existing and Proposed Street Scene], [Garage Proposed Floor Plan], [Garage Proposed Roof Plan], [Proposed Front and Rear Elevations], [Proposed Side Elevations], Received: 27/10/2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The use of the outbuilding as adapted in accordance with this approval shall be for the purpose of a gym/office by occupiers of or for any other purpose incidental to the residential use of the dwelling known as 22 Regency Mews, and not as a self-contained dwelling nor as a business premises, nor shall any kitchen, bathroom, toilet or bedroom(s) be installed in the outbuilding without the permission of the Local Planning Authority obtained through the submission of a planning application.
